provenance.gene_mapping: Exact author RefSeq/Gene ID map and the author RefSeq FASTA Entrez IDs. No human ortholog assignment.

provenance.KEGG: Official ame gene-to-pathway links and ame pathway names. Exclude broad ame011xx/ame012xx overview maps.
provenance.scope: Union of the three tissue-specific protein/RNA teaching pools; every term with a mapped member is retained. Per-query background is the annotated fitted model genes.
